security_spec.violation_condition: When Linux kernel modifies non-leaf IOMMU page table entries (e.g., freeing intermediate page table levels during unmap, splitting/merging huge-page mappings, or changing PMD/PUD directory pointers) on an IOMMU that does not support the Non-Leaf PTE Invalidation Extension (IOM_330), and the IOMMU driver either omits the required fallback global invalidation (IOTINVAL.VMA/GVMA with all-ones mask) or incorrectly assumes non-leaf invalidation is always available without checking capabilities.NLONE.GATS/NAGTS bits.
security_spec.summary: IOMMU Non-Leaf PTE Invalidation absence (SHOULD, not MUST) creates stale-IOATC risk: if kernel modifies intermediate page table entries without capability-gated fallback to global invalidation, cached non-leaf translations persist, allowing DMA to freed/reallocated memory
